title: انیمیشن من فرانکلدا هستم
description: I Am Frankelda is a 2025 stop motion animated gothic musical dark fantasy film written and directed by Arturo and Roy Ambriz. It is a prequel to the Cartoon Network Latin America television series Frankelda's Book of Spooks, becoming the first Mexican film made entirely in stop-motion technique, and features the voices of Mireya Mendoza, Arturo Mercado Jr. and Luis Leonardo Suárez. The plot follows Francisca Imelda, a young aspiring writer in Post-colonial Mexico and her struggles to fulfill her dreams after being approached by a prince who needs her help to save his kingdom.
